title: ficus glandulifera
intro: Ficus glandulifera, commonly known as the Banyan fig, is a species of fig tree that belongs to the family Moraceae. The Banyan fig is known for its extensive aerial roots that form a distinctive network of roots and trunks, providing shade and shelter. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fever, as well as treating digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Ficus glandulifera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
